diagnosticPrivacyProjection: tree_error raw text excluded; nonempty, byte length and SHA-256 preserved; original process files unchanged

conditions.timestampBasis: Coordinator local clock observations of user messages; not sender-supplied timestamps
conditions.ownedHeavyCampaignOverlapBasis: Coordinator released sequential performance campaign after owned validation jobs closed
conditions.order: fixed baseline then current for each case; 1000 first; 10000 last instrumented; separate clock-only1000 pair afterwards
conditions.repeats: first activation n1; same-fixture off/reactivation n3 for 10/100/1000 only; remaining cases n1; no statistical stability assumed
conditions.causalQualification: The user reported the PC unused and no playing. Fixed order, cache warming and temporal variation still limit causal attribution; do not pool historical windows
conditions.apiBudgetQualification: Caps apply to whole workers including setup and native proofs. Source/build preparation and outer controller are separate; never label a cap as completed API latency.
conditions.diskBudgetEnforcement: Advisory metadata only. The unchanged runner does not enforce a physical filesystem quota or a hard 4 GiB stop. Endpoint file-data allocation is measured separately and is not a peak or device-IO measure.

sourceBinding.coreTupleAlgorithm: SHA256(JSON.stringify(full manifest src/core path/hash pairs in manifest order))

separateClockPair.scope: Separate fresh-fixture complete-API clock-only1000 pair; n1 per completed operation; never pooled or used as profiler overhead correction
